# Decision Log — Satoshi’s Council Method

One row per meaningful decision. Process grade first. Outcome second.

| Field | Entry |
|-------|--------|
| **Date / Time** | |
| **Question** (one sentence) | |
| **Horizon** (hours / days / weeks) | |
| **Ranked inputs used** (top 3–5 agents or sources + lean) | 1.  2.  3. |
| **Confluence level** (e.g. 3 of 4 top seats agree / weak / conflicted) | |
| **Decision** (Accumulate / Reduce / Maintain / **Stand down**) | |
| **Confidence** (0–100) + brief why | |
| **Later outcome** | |
| **Process grade** (0–100) | Rule adherence __ / Horizon honesty __ / Ranked inputs recorded __ / Outcome noted __ |
| **Notes** (ego, noise, or what to adjust) | |

**Scoring reminder**  
- Rule adherence (confluence threshold met **or** Wait correctly issued): 40 pts  
- Horizon honesty (horizon stated when action taken): 20 pts  
- Ranked inputs recorded: 20 pts  
- Outcome later noted: 20 pts  

A clean Wait with full logging can score 100. A lucky call that ignored confluence scores low.
